item.title: [LU-20673] interop sanity test_27cg: setstripe failed
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Andreas Dilger <adilger@dilger.ca>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/df2265f8-c35f-4596-9a0c-b53345f620b8

test_27cg failed with the following error:

lfs setstripe: setstripe error for '/mnt/lustre/f27cg.sanity': Input/output error
 sanity test_27cg: @@@@@@ FAIL: setstripe failed

Test session details:

Interop

Client
Lustre: 2.17.56.51
Branch: master
Build: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-reviews/130440
Kernel: 5.14.0-611.55.1.el9_7.x86_64

Server
Lustre: 2.16.1.2
Branch: b2_16
Build: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-b2_16/6
Kernel: 5.14.0-427.31.1_lustre.el9.x86_64

Has failed 8x in the past week of interop testing, which itself doesn't run very often.

The root cause needs to be investigated, since setstripe of a wide striped file itself shouldn't fail with a 2.16 server, so this seems like a real interop issue, and the test shouldn't just be skipped.

VVVVVVV DO NOT REMOVE LINES BELOW, Added by Maloo for auto-association VVVVVVV
sanity test_27cg - setstripe failed

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
The sanity test_27cg was added in commit v2_15_54-2-g9e6225b2e7 but should only be testing the number of ldiskfs transaction credits being used. However, it appears that something is causing the client to be evicted when it submits a 128KiB overstripe RPC with "lfs setstripe -o 0,0,{repeat 997x},0":

[  909.285484] Lustre: DEBUG MARKER: == sanity test 27cg: 1000 shouldn't cause too many credits ========================================================== 02:46:17 (1788317177)
[  909.837374] LustreError: 9307:0:(events.c:317:request_in_callback()) event type 2, status -113, service mdt
[  910.027234] Lustre: 107416:0:(client.c:2497:ptlrpc_expire_one_request()) @@@ Request sent has failed due to network error: [sent 1788317178/real 1788317178]  req@ff19e5745c276700 x1875185697984640/t0(0) o101->lustre-MDT0000-mdc-ff19e57443e6a800@10.240.39.252@tcp:12/10 lens 24568/131856 e 0 to 1 dl 1788317194 ref 2 fl Rpc:eXPQr/600/ffffffff rc 0/-1 job:'lfs.0' uid:0 gid:0 projid:0
[  910.027471] Lustre: 107416:0:(client.c:2497:ptlrpc_expire_one_request()) Skipped 3 previous similar messages
[  910.027655] Lustre: lustre-MDT0000-mdc-ff19e57443e6a800: Connection to lustre-MDT0000 (at 10.240.39.252@tcp) was lost; in progress operations using this service will wait for recovery to complete
[  910.027776] Lustre: Skipped 24 previous similar messages
[  910.028387] LustreError: MGC10.240.39.252@tcp: Connection to MGS (at 10.240.39.252@tcp) was lost; in progress operations using this service will fail
[  946.077495] Lustre: lustre-OST0004-osc-ff19e57443e6a800: disconnect after 24s idle
[  961.439399] Lustre: Evicted from MGS (at 10.240.39.252@tcp) after server handle changed from 0x48bdd33eb65c6021 to 0x48bdd33eb69543f5
[  961.440521] LustreError: lustre-MDT0000-mdc-ff19e57443e6a800: This client was evicted by lustre-MDT0000; in progress operations using this service will fail.

It looks like this is an RPC size limit issue that the old MDS is rejecting but the client retries until it is evicted, and not directly related to the overstripe/credits issue, but unlikely to cause issues in the real world (normally overstriping is handled by "-C 1000" or more recently "-C -4"), so I think skipping it is OK. It doesn't represent an "interop" issue per-se, just missing functionality for this subtest on the old MDS.
I'm running a Claude session to investigate this issue, if it can be reproduced and isolated to a specific cause.
This is another instance of the TCP Zero Copy code being enabled by default for VM nodes.
LU-20770 has a patch that should fix this.
